## technique
- concept: Logarithmic Product and Quotient Rules
  description: Combine logarithmic terms with the same base using the product rule ($\log A + \log B = \log(AB)$) and quotient rule ($\log A - \log B = \log(A/B)$).
  cues:
    - problem involves a sum or difference of logarithms with identical bases; the goal is to consolidate terms into a single logarithm.
  implementation:
    - apply $\log_b A + \log_b B = \log_b (AB)$ to sum terms
    - apply $\log_b A - \log_b B = \log_b (A/B)$ to difference terms
- concept: Logarithmic Power Rule and Coefficient Extraction
  description: Move coefficients in front of logarithms to become exponents of the argument ($k \log A = \log(A^k)$) and vice versa.
  cues:
    - problem involves a logarithm with a fractional or integer coefficient; the goal is to eliminate the coefficient or combine it with other terms.
  implementation:
    - move coefficient $k$ to the exponent: $k \log_b A \to \log_b (A^k)$
    - move exponent to coefficient: $\log_b (A^k) \to k \log_b A$
